name: ZCode ACP
description: ACP bridge for ZCode — Zhipu's GLM coding agent on the desktop. Drives the locally installed and signed-in ZCode engine over its native app-server protocol (streaming thinking/output, tool cards, permissions, session list/resume/fork, native sub-agents); the model list mirrors the engine registry, so your own ZCode subscription plans show up and are switchable. No API keys are proxied. macOS; requires the ZCode desktop app and Python 3.
